correctness.rationale: For every integer \(m\ge2\), exact conditional Dirichlet quadratic moments on j-fold translated simplices and inclusion-exclusion establish E[MG]. A separate exponential-rank expansion in checks/exact_replay.py verifies all integer sizes two through thirty in rational arithmetic; bounded finite checks are not used as universal proof.

value.rationale: Maximum gap and Greenwood quadratic statistic are distinct, well-motivated uniform-spacing null tests. The exact finite-sample mixed null moment, uniform strict positive sign and sharp slow Pearson decay quantify their overlap in simultaneous diagnostic use. This is not a restatement of one marginal test law, an arbitrary parameter slice, or a generic sign check: it supplies a closed structural joint identity, without claiming downstream calibrated combined-test thresholds.
